items.headline: Price move coincides with 2 major outage(s) same day
items.detail: Wide intraday MCP spread: 141% of daily average on 2026-05-21, same day as: BELLARY TPS unit 1: 500.0 MW affected; ADANI POWER unit 2: 600.0 MW affected (~1100 MW total affected capacity). Reduced supply is a plausible contributing driver, alongside demand-side factors -- not asserted as the sole cause.
